raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: base
  opam_name: base
  version: "0.17.3"
  build_number: 1

  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  # static archive paired with the .cmxa: msvc ships .lib, gcc and unix ship .a
  native_lib_ext: ${{ ".lib" if c_compiler == "vs" else ".a" }}
  # ELF machine token `file` prints for the target; checked by the arch test
  elf_arch: ${{ "x86-64" if target_platform == "linux-64" else "aarch64" if target_platform == "linux-aarch64" else "PowerPC" if target_platform == "linux-ppc64le" else "RISC-V" if target_platform == "linux-riscv64" else "S/390" if target_platform == "linux-s390x" else "" }}

package:
  name: ocaml-${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/janestreet/base/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3f3f64789ab25bb5cb7f5f907dd651dec9cc9440981822fe75df6b94344b7208
  patches:
    # MSVC rejects __attribute__((unused)) (C2143); keep the stub portable
    - patches/0001-obj_stubs-drop-gcc-attribute-for-msvc.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - dune build -p ${{ opam_name }} --profile=release -j "${CPU_COUNT:-1}" @install
        - dune install -p ${{ opam_name }} --prefix="${PREFIX}" --libdir="${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml" --docdir="${PREFIX}/share/doc" --mandir="${PREFIX}/share/man"
      else:
        # Plain cmd.exe, not MSYS2 bash: the C stubs need only the activated
        # toolchain, and the backslashed install prefix reaches dune intact. The
        # dune cache trips over mixed path separators on windows.
        # dune install also opens the shared cache; disable it for every dune call
        - set DUNE_CACHE=disabled
        # host libs (dune-configurator, sexplib0, ...) live in %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\ocaml; non-unix activation only lists BUILD_PREFIX
        - set "OCAMLPATH=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\ocaml;%OCAMLPATH%"
        - dune build -p ${{ opam_name }} --cache=disabled --profile=release @install
        - if errorlevel 1 exit 1
        - dune install -p ${{ opam_name }} --prefix="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%" --libdir="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\ocaml" --docdir="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\doc" --mandir="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\man"
        - if errorlevel 1 exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      else:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # C stubs and the discover.exe step: a C compiler on every lane
    - if: unix
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    # ocaml_win-64 >=14 only run-constrains the C compiler; activate it here, once (vs, zig)
    - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("zig") if c_compiler == "zig" else compiler("c") }}
    # compiler("ocaml") renders no toolchain track; name it on windows
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # the cross compiler does not pull the native one; the build runs OCaml on the build machine
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # the cross compiler activates itself (shims, OCAMLLIB, host OCAMLPATH)
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # windows cross: the self-contained gcc track needs no vcvars
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
    - ocaml-dune >=3.11
  host:
    # library: ocaml's run_export pins the compiler patch version
    - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    # the noarch ocaml metapackage does not pin the windows toolchain track
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    - ocaml-dune >=3.11
    - ocaml-dune-configurator
    - ocaml-intrinsics-kernel >=0.17.0,<0.18
    - ocaml-sexplib0 >=0.17.0,<0.18
  run:
    - ocaml-intrinsics-kernel >=0.17.0,<0.18
    - ocaml-sexplib0 >=0.17.0,<0.18
  # the ocaml run_export does not encode the windows toolchain track
  run_constraints:
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # installed dune-package declares (lang dune X.Y); older dune cannot read it
    - ${{ pin_compatible('ocaml-dune', lower_bound='x.x', upper_bound=None) }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/META
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/${{ opam_name }}.cma
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/${{ opam_name }}.cmi
        # win-arm64 is bytecode-only upstream: OCaml 5.4 has no arm64 Windows backend
        - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
          then:
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/${{ opam_name }}.cmxa
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/${{ opam_name }}.cmxs
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/${{ opam_name }}/${{ opam_name }}${{ native_lib_ext }}

  # link test: needs a toolchain that runs on the build machine and a native backend
  # win-arm64 is bytecode-only (no native link)
  - if: build_platform == target_platform and target_platform != "win-arm64"
    then:
      script:
        interpreter: bash
        content:
          - export DUNE_CACHE=disabled
          - LIBDIR=$PREFIX/lib/ocaml; SEP=':'
          - if [[ -d $PREFIX/Library/lib/ocaml ]]; then LIBDIR=$PREFIX/Library/lib/ocaml; SEP=';'; fi
          - export OCAMLPATH="$LIBDIR${OCAMLPATH:+$SEP$OCAMLPATH}"
          - echo '(lang dune 3.0)' > dune-project
          - echo '(executable (name t) (libraries base) (link_flags (-linkall)))' > dune
          - echo 'let () = assert (Base.Int.popcount 7 = 3); print_string (Base.String.uppercase "base ok")' > t.ml
          - dune build --root . ./t.exe
          - ./_build/default/t.exe | grep -q "BASE OK"
      requirements:
        run:
          - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
          - ocaml-dune >=3.11
          - if: unix
            then:
              - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          - if: not unix
            then:
              - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
              - m2-bash
              - m2-coreutils
              - m2-grep
          - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
            then:
              - ${{ compiler("c") }}

  # cross lanes test under qemu binfmt, which would also run a build-machine
  # binary; check the native objects' ELF headers name the target instead
  - if: linux
    then:
      script:
        # test scripts are not jinja-rendered; hand the token over by env
        env:
          ELF_ARCH: ${{ elf_arch }}
        content:
          - mkdir -p objs
          - cd objs
          - ar x "${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml/base/base.a"
          - file -L ./*.o
          - test -z "$(file -L ./*.o | grep -v "${ELF_ARCH}")"
      requirements:
        build:
          - file
          - binutils

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/janestreet/base
  repository: https://github.com/janestreet/base
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Full standard library replacement for OCaml (Jane Street)

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - ManuelLerchner
